description: Take a draft form or staged changes live. Needs a login token (FILLO_TOKEN or `npx @usefillo/cli login`); a `pk_` publishable key cannot complete this owner action. The form may be identified by id, slug, or stable push handle. Publishing is idempotent: an already-live form with nothing staged succeeds unchanged. If existing responses use fields the staged schema removes or re-types, retry with allowBreaking=true when the user authorized those changes; otherwise ask for their decision. File forms must have ready storage before they can go live.

allowBreaking.description: Acknowledge removing or re-typing fields that existing responses answered. Use true when the user authorized these field removals or type changes; otherwise ask for their decision.

form.description: Form id, hosted slug, or stable push handle.

name: fillo_publish_form
title: Publish a Fillo form
